caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of light-colored fabric, possibly linen, decorated with numerous small floral motifs arranged in a grid pattern that occupies most of the central area. Each motif is unique, featuring different varieties of flowers, small plants, and occasional birds, all rendered in a palette that includes yellow, pink, red, blue, green, and purple. The designs are densely grouped but spaced enough to distinguish each figure. The vertical left side of the fabric has a wide, ornate border with a repeating floral pattern, incorporating the same colors found in the central motifs. The remaining three sides have a narrow, fringed edge. The background of the overall image is a pale beige tone, separating the textile from the page or background of the drawing. Handwritten text appears on the lower right, reading "MARY BERNER."
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
